title: Catching up with a friend after a long gap
objectives: Greet an old friend and ask how things are going
Congratulate the friend and show interest
Suggest catching up in person at a specific time

courseTemplate.setting: The partner recently got promoted and will be in the learner's city in March.

roles.learner: A friend reconnecting after six months
roles.partner: An old friend who lives in Melbourne

courseTemplate.openingLine: Hey! It's been about six months, hasn't it?

targetPatterns.pattern: It has! How's everything going in Melbourne?
targetPatterns.example: It has! How's everything going in Melbourne?

targetPatterns.pattern: Congratulations! How's the new role going?
targetPatterns.example: Congratulations! How's the new role going?

targetPatterns.pattern: Would you like to have dinner while you're here in March?
targetPatterns.example: Would you like to have dinner while you're here in March?

targetPatterns.pattern: It's been ages! We should catch up properly.
targetPatterns.example: It's been ages! We should catch up properly.
targetPatterns.translation: 好久没见了，该好好聊聊了。

targetPatterns.pattern: How have things been on your end?
targetPatterns.example: How have things been on your end?

targetPatterns.pattern: Let's not wait another year to meet up.
targetPatterns.example: Let's not wait another year to meet up.

targetPatterns.pattern: Happy birthday — hope your day is amazing!
targetPatterns.example: Happy birthday — hope your day is amazing!
targetPatterns.translation: 生日快乐，希望你今天超开心！

targetPatterns.pattern: I saw this and thought of you.
targetPatterns.example: I saw this and thought of you.

targetPatterns.pattern: Are you still in town next month?
targetPatterns.example: Are you still in town next month?
targetPatterns.translation: 你下个月还在这个城市吗？

targetPatterns.pattern: Let's do a proper catch-up call this weekend.
targetPatterns.example: Let's do a proper catch-up call this weekend.
targetPatterns.translation: 这周末我们好好打个电话。

stages.title: Greet an old friend and ask how things are going
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Hey! It's been about six months, hasn't it?”
successCriteria: The learner can greet an old friend and ask how things are going in their own words.
hints: You can start with “It has! How's everything …”

stages.title: Congratulate the friend and show interest
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Busy but good. I got promoted this spring.”
successCriteria: The learner can congratulate the friend and show interest in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Congratulations! How's the new …”

stages.title: Suggest catching up in person at a specific time
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “It's going well. I'll be in your city for a conference in March.”
successCriteria: The learner can suggest catching up in person at a specific time in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Would you like to …”

modelDialogue.text: Hey! It's been about six months, hasn't it?
It has! How's everything going in Melbourne?
Busy but good. I got promoted this spring.
Congratulations! How's the new role going?
It's going well. I'll be in your city for a conference in March.
Would you like to have dinner while you're here in March?
